home.core_pattern_desc: Every AI coding agent shares the same loop: call the model, execute tools, feed results back. Production systems add policy, permissions, and lifecycle layers on top.
home.learning_path_desc: 12 progressive sessions, from a simple loop to isolated autonomous execution
home.layers_desc: Five orthogonal concerns that compose into a complete agent
home.message_flow_desc: Watch the messages array grow as the agent loop executes

mobile_app.title: A Mobile App Page You Can Open on Phone
mobile_app.subtitle: This page is optimized for mobile viewing while keeping a clear desktop layout. You can preview an app-like interface directly in browser.
mobile_app.feature_mobile_desc: The interface starts with a single-column card flow and keeps touch-friendly spacing, buttons, and text sizing.
mobile_app.feature_player_desc: The screen design is ready to host inline cover images, playback controls, and generated audio/video blocks.
mobile_app.feature_sync_desc: Desktop still looks clean, while phone users get a focused app-like page without horizontal scrolling.

layers.title: Architectural Layers
layers.subtitle: Five orthogonal concerns that compose into a complete agent
layers.tools: What the agent CAN do. The foundation: tools give the model capabilities to interact with the world.
layers.planning: How work is organized. From simple todo lists to dependency-aware task boards shared across agents.
layers.memory: Keeping context within limits. Compression strategies that let agents work infinitely without losing coherence.
layers.concurrency: Non-blocking execution. Background threads and notification buses for parallel work.
layers.collaboration: Multi-agent coordination. Teams, messaging, and autonomous teammates that think for themselves.

paro.subtitle: A web console for the Python agent loop. Chat with the model, watch tool calls land in real time, and keep the workspace in view while the agent works.
paro.uploads_empty: Uploaded files are stored on the backend and their paths are injected into this session automatically.
paro.conversation_hint: Talk to the agent like a coding partner. The backend keeps the session state.
paro.runtime_hint: Tool calls, command output, compaction, and turn lifecycle events appear here.
paro.runtime_empty: No runtime events yet. Start with one of the prompts below or type your own task.
paro.runtime_stopping: Stop requested. Waiting for the current step to finish safely.
paro.runtime_stop_idle: This turn already finished, so there is nothing left to stop.
paro.empty_body: Ask it to inspect files, run tests, edit code, or explain what it finds. Key loop events appear inline in the conversation while the final answer stays as a full message.
paro.placeholder: Ask Paro to inspect the repo, run commands, or change code...
paro.error_default: Unable to reach the Paro backend.
paro.example_1: Summarize this repository and tell me how to run it.
paro.example_2: List the key Python files and explain what each one does.
paro.example_3: Inspect the web app and tell me where to hook a new feature.
